description: A React functional component named LanguageSelector that provides a UI for selecting the application's language. It manages dropdown state, interacts with utility functions for getting and setting languages, and calls a callback when the language changes.

methods.name: LanguageSelector({ onLanguageChange })
methods.description: React component allowing users to select UI language, managing dropdown visibility and current language state, and invoking external utility functions and callback on change.

methods.name: handleLanguageSelect
methods.description: Handles user selection of a language, updates state, sets the language via utility, and triggers callback.
